standard_prerequisites.name: Derivability from assumptions
standard_prerequisites.statement: Gamma proves !A when there is a derivation of !A in which every undischarged assumption is a sentence in Gamma.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the relation the counted proposition and proof operate on (771-779).

core_obligations: Take the derivation consisting of the single assumption !A itself (777-778).
Its only undischarged assumption is !A, which belongs to Gamma by hypothesis, so Gamma proves !A (778-779).
